newsitem.title: USA: Mother abandons children in Central Park.
newsitem.headline: Mother abandons children in Central Park.

text.p: A young mother who left her toddler and infant in Central Park while she went to buy ice cream and never returned was arrested early Wednesday, police said.

A police spokesman said the woman was traced to her Manhattan apartment in the early hours of the morning and charged with abandonment and endangering the welfare of the children. She was identifed as 33-year-old Lori Ann Williamston.
Police had offered a reward of $5,000 Tuesday for information leading to the parents of the children just hours after the two girls were abandoned at a park playground.
The girls, one about 2 years old and the other about 9 months, were left with a stroller, baby formula, cereal, clothing and toys.

The mother had asked a nanny who was looking after another child in the playground to watch the girls while she went to buy ice cream. The nanny called police when the woman failed to return after almost an hour.
